additional_info.subject: ID0397027-DC/Si-D/FR[zaBsY8 & E7UBEl] - Failsafemode_Active CRM:00315002209
additional_info.body:
Dear Jessica Mina,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / P5 170000510
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
zaBsY8 & E7UBEl
Problem Description
: FailsafeMode due to KF11 and KF12 not being present in network
Troubleshooting
: For
zaBsY8 the KF12 is missing from the network and for E7UBEl it's KF11, unfortunately, for this kind of error there is nothing I can do remotely, you need to go on-site and check if there is something wrong with the wires. Check if we have 24V at the input of KFs, if you have and it still doesn't work, check if changing the Ethernet cable works. As last option please replace the component.
For zaBsY8 the Warranty is Expired but for E7UBEl the warranty is still valid.
For future reference, your case number is
0397027
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
